rounds.notes: Copilot code-review round on renderer.mjs raised 3 concerns (4 threads, one duplicated): dead `cols` variable, unhandled 'stalled'/'error' RunStats outcomes in the heatmap, and unescaped weapon/seed interpolated into innerHTML.
